blocks.html: Tanks shall be located at least 7 feet (2133.6 mm), measured in the most direct manner, from any source of exposed flame unless protected as provided in Section 1305.11.1.2, exception 3, and at least 2 feet (609.6 mm) from any surface where the temperature exceeds 165° F (73.9° C).
